title: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
premise: On a drowsy summer afternoon, Alice follows a White Rabbit with a pocket watch down a rabbit hole, into a world where nothing makes sense.

moments.title: Down the rabbit hole
moments.happened: Alice follows the White Rabbit and tumbles into Wonderland.

moments.title: The pool of tears
moments.happened: Alice grows enormous and cries a pool of tears, then shrinks and nearly drowns in it.
alternatives: Alice never drinks from the bottle
Alice keeps hold of the key

moments.title: The Cheshire Cat
moments.happened: A grinning cat in a tree tells Alice that everyone here is mad.
alternatives: The Cat comes along with Alice

moments.title: The Mad Tea-Party
moments.happened: Alice joins the Hatter, the March Hare and the Dormouse at a tea-party that never ends.

moments.title: The Queen’s croquet
moments.happened: Alice plays croquet with flamingos while the Queen of Hearts orders heads off.

moments.title: The trial of the Knave
moments.happened: At the trial over the stolen tarts, Alice grows huge and calls the court “nothing but a pack of cards.”
